title: Registrations declare each word's artifact set, primitive and move
summary: A `@system` discriminator entry may add artifact-set, primitive and move rows (closed kernel values); every public word now declares them and the vocabulary catalogue (ia vocabulary --json, the MCP door catalogue, docs/reference/language) and the per-word references carry them. A row outside the kernel refuses the entry; absent rows leave a registration without them. Every entry row is written once: a second category, facets, schema, artifact-set, primitive or move row refuses the entry, reported at the second row. The kernel digest and every derived revision change accordingly.
